title: A broken promise
speaker: X GOD
caption: Kilina was promised protection.
Her own home was marked for extraction.
alt: X finds Witchwood's coordinates targeted on Kilina's surviving observatory records.

title: The route to Dread Planet
speaker: TELEPORTATION C
caption: The charts lead to Dread Planet.
Nico has a ship ready for you.
alt: C shares the recovered interplanetary route with X as Nico's prepared Starbreak ship waits outside Witchwood.

title: A familiar light
speaker: Z-GOD
caption: X! I kept looking for you.
I'm right here.
alt: Z-God steps confidently from a small stellar flare as X recognizes his surviving little sister.

title: Still here
speaker: X GOD
caption: I was afraid I'd never see you again.
Together. Whatever comes next.
alt: X and Z-God share a relieved sibling embrace beside the ready Starbreak ship.
